items.title: Edgar "Sambo" Joseph Interview, 1960-08-07
items.q: I had Emma, Emma, Emma the sweet, the bell go with you and her... She said, Ms. Claiborne Williams said, Joseph, this ain't your card. This is Emma, Emma the bell girl.

ctx.x: You set aside and you see. You can tell a different. And then that's so, I'm the wisest in town like I've been running to my little band. I'm on to many of them fellas. Many fellas say I try to be hard, but I'm not no hard fella. See, when a man hire me, I'm going to try and give a man service. I want to come back to a man. I don't want to never go back to the same man. I make me feel proud to go back. Well, if I go there doing it wrong, I'm never going to go back to the man. He's my wrong. See, the man's going…
